title: Remote contexts absent
description: The top-level @context is not a string, and where it is an array, no member of the array is a string. In JSON-LD a string there is the web address of a context to be fetched, so what the file means would depend on what that address returns when it is read. Any string is refused, whether or not it looks like a URL. Contexts below the top level are refused by context-at-root-only.
summary: The `@context` never refers by web address to a context kept elsewhere

errorMessage.not: the @context never refers by web address to a context kept elsewhere
